Stop when differences nobody accepted remain

Source: R/accept.R
check_differences.Rd

For continuous integration: stops with an error that lists the differences of the comparison that are not accepted (see accept_differences()) and match the filters, so the job fails; returns TRUE invisibly when there are none.

Usage

check_differences(
  x,
  kind = NULL,
  max_severity = if (is.null(kind)) 1L,
  no_news = NULL
)

Arguments

x

An pkgdossier_comparison from compare_runs().

kind

Consider only these kinds.

max_severity

Consider differences of this severity or more severe (1 is the most severe: new errors, removed elements and exports). Defaults to 1, or, when kind is given, to no limit: the kinds named are checked whatever their severity.

no_news

TRUE considers only differences no NEWS bullet names.

Value

TRUE, invisibly, when no such difference remains.

Details

The filters are those of differences(), in the same order.

Examples

# \donttest{
d <- example_dossier()
prepare_versions(d, quiet = TRUE)
run_scenarios(d, quiet = TRUE)
cmp <- compare_runs(d)
try(check_differences(cmp, max_severity = 1))
#> Error : 5 difference(s) of severity 1 or more severe are not accepted:
#>   unstable api/noisy 
#>   field_removed api/result res$b
#>   error_new api/check error
#>   argument_new_required (namespace)/extend_result keep
#>   argument_removed (namespace)/warn_gone verbose
#> Accept the intended ones with accept_differences().
# }
